Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb! Wouldn't it be great...if there were trampolines...everywhere you went?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, Ferb! Incredible hang time!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Pulls out small gadget) Personal anti-gravity device.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That gives me an idea. I know what we're gonna do...today!...Hey... (bounces and switches on his anti-gravity device) Where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. Doofenshmirtz was spotted this morning leaving his building with a shopping list. On the list were four items

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa. Did you just feel something?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Morning, hon.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mmm, that smells good. I'll get the plates out.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, put out ten, because I was talking to Jeremy's mom earlier, and we thought it would be fun to get us all together for brunch this morning.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait. So the whole Johnson family, and our whole family, together?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, this is the first time both of our families have formally gone together!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Honey, relax. It's just a casual brunch. No big deal.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No big deal? I'm Jeremy's girlfriend! We have to make a good impression! Breakfast is easy! This is brunch! Brunch! That's so fancy! Mom, what does this frittata say about us as a family?

Name: Linda
Dialog: There's nothing wrong with my frittata.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And frozen orange juice?! Really?! (dumps orange mix into a pitcher of water and pants) I can't breathe. Where do we keep the paper bags?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (at Phineas and Ferb) Hey guys, I know you ate earlier, but you wanna join us for brunch?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! No! No! They'll embarrass me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Aw, we can't mom, we're on our way to the hardware store to pick up some extra parts.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Alright two less plates then.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Good! Is this house even clean enough for this? (Picking up a few magazines) Let's see, monster trucks on the bottom, book review on top. That should impress 'em. (She looks out the window and sees Phineas and Ferb's personal anti-gravity device) Oh no! No! No! That is hideous! (As she walks into the backyard) What the heck did they build out here? (Reading) "Anti-gravity Maximus." Oh, I have got to get rid of this thing. (She begins to haul it away, but the machine zaps her, causing her to levitate in the air) No, no. No! No- Ahhh! (Clings onto the tree) Phineas and Ferb! Not today! Not now! If Jeremy's parents see me like this, that's the end of me seeing him. Come on, there's gotta be a reverse switch on this thing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excuse me, sir. Where do you keep the reverse switches?

Name: Store employee
Dialog: Right behind ya'. Next to that guy buying self-destruct buttons.

Name: Store employee
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz Aww, sweet. Fifty cents off with coupon.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my gosh! They're here!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) Candace, my hands are full. Could you get the door?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm on it mom. (Candace works her way across the lawn, keeping herself leveled to the best of her ability)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, Suzy. Are you excited to see Candace?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Yes. I love Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm coming. Just a few more feet. (she opens the door for the Johnson family) Jeremy, and the whole family, welcome to our humble dwelling.

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Good morning, Candace. Where's your mom? Oh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: She's in the kitchen, Mrs. Johnson. It's right through there.

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Okay, here we go.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, it's just so nice to see you. I just can't stop hugging you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Anytime you're ready, Ferb.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (As she walks into the backyard) Hey, Phineas? What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Isabella. We're blasting this pile of trampolines with an anti gravity machine, so we can bounce all over town.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Why not blast ourselves with anti-gravity?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, then we couldn't bounce. Blast 'em, Ferb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, guys. Follow me!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (With a tear in his eye) It's so beautiful!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford?! You are crying!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (He removes the tear off his eye and puts it on Baljeet) No, I'm not. You're crying!

Name: Doofenshmirtz Recording
Dialog: Good morning, Perry the Platypus. I had to step out for a minute, but please, help yourself to some gnosh. Eggs, vitamins, ice, or leeks. I have no idea what you platypuses eat, but whatever you do, don't destroy my new evil -inator. (Perry takes a nearby sledge hammer and go to destroy the -inator, however, Perry's feet get trapped in braces) A-ha! You're trapped! A-hahahaha Sucker!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Do you like it Perry the Platypus? It's my new Tell-the-Truth-inator! One blast from this baby, and people will be forced to tell the truth. It features an Abe Lincoln robot. He doesn't actually serve any functional purpose, he just decoration. But he's-he's thematically linked to honesty. Y-You know through his-his nickname "Honest Abe". But enough about me, let me ask you this. Have you ever wondered what it is that holds the fabric of society together? No it's not cooperation, or trust or any of that stuff hippies want you to believe, it's lies. All the little white lies we tell each other. You see Perry the Platypus...

Name: Woman
Dialog: You look good in that hat.

Name: Man
Dialog: I don't think you have too many cats.

Name: Man 2
Dialog: Your hair looks nice when it's up like that.

Name: Woman 2
Dialog: Oh dear, the house looks great.

Name: Blay'n
Dialog: You haven't put on any weight.

Name: Woman 3
Dialog: Oh, I thought you said eight.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Did ya' hear that high note? That was the A above middle C, not too shabby.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, will you pour the OJ?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sure, Mom. There's got to be something heavy in here. (She finds a wrench, and pushes it into her shoe, weighing her down somewhat) OJ, did you know that stood for Orange Juice? 'Cause I didn't. (Nervous chuckle) Well, its not fresh, but it was an impromptu brunch. Brunch

Name: Baseball Announcer
Dialog: It's a beautiful day for a ball game!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (On his hovering platform) It won't be a beautiful day for long. Not after they all start telling the truth about each other. I'll start with that hotdog guy down there. Wait 'till the world hears what's in those things. And fire!

Name: Vendor
Dialog: Hotdogs, get your hotdogs! (He gets zapped) They're aren't really any hotdogs in here, I just wanted to get in the game for free.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh, I didn't see that one coming. Well let's just see what the players have to say.

Name: Catcher
Dialog: Here comes a fastball.

Name: Batter
Dialog: Thanks pal. (He hits the ball sending it flying, up to where Doofenshmirtz is, and hitting the Abe Lincoln robot)

Name: Baseball Announcer
Dialog: And it's out of here!

Name: Abe Lincoln Robot
Dialog: Malfunctioning. Loyalties shifting.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Let's see what embarrassing truths that woman who's holding that unusually large hand mirror has to say. (He fires, but the rays bounces back and hits Doofenshmirtz) Secretly I'm very lonely. Where did that come from?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How about some lemonade?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (bursts into the garage) Phineas! There you are! This is all your fault! That machine of yours has made me lighter than air!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I just mentioned that, I thought it would be so fun to shoot at--

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Not a good time for that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm trying to make a good impression on Jeremy's parents (Suzy peeks around the garage door, and eavesdrops on the conversation) and I can't even keep my feet on the ground!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I guess we should install that reverse button now. We wouldn't want you bouncing off the ceiling during brunch.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: That would be a little rough on the old frittata.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just hurry before I make an even bigger fool of myself

Name: Abe Robot
Dialog: It is all together fitting and proper that I must destroy Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! Get back! Ahhh!

Name: Abe Robot
Dialog: Must destroy Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (While hiding behind Perry) He's gonna John Wilkes my Booth! (a beat) What, too soon? Ahh! Getting a little too honest here, Abe!

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, Mrs. Johnson, it's so great to talk to each other like adults. (Suzy crawls under the table, and pulls out the wrench weighing candace down) Just me and you talking all adulty and stuff, and (Candace notices her leg has floated up) WHOA! (She giggles nervously before floating up entirely, just managing to hold onto the table) Ahh! Just doin' a little yoga stretch to help this digestion, yep. Heh.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Good thing she's wearing her skort.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, do something! He's going to emancipate my proclamation!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (While bouncing) What's up Honest Abe? Looks like the old Doofster's a little too, smart for y-- (The Abe Lincoln robot grabs Doofenshmirtz from the air) Oh, hehehe, hi, you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Still hanging on by the table) Hahaha! Did I ever tell you I'm thinking of taking gymnastics next year? Haha!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Awesome.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: (Still under the table) Gymnastics? How about aerobatics?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ow! Ow! O-Oh my gosh. (Giggles nervously) Well, that's eh enough gymnastics for now. (She manages to sit back down, and wrap her leg around the char, grounding herself)

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Candace, can you juggle with this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! put that down. Suzy that's my 1984 collectable Ducky Momo plate, where they printed the entire design upside down. It's priceless.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Mmm, oh whoopsy. (She throws the plate)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (In slow motion) Noooooo! (She manages to catch it with her mouth.)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace Flynn, what has gotten into you?! (Candace is grabbing onto Mrs. Johnson's head with her feet to keep herself from floating.) I want the truth, and nothing but the truth!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (speaks muffled then takes the plate out of her mouth) The truth...?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! No! Get off!

Name: Abe Robot
Dialog: Honest Abe Lincoln Smash!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now look what you've done. We're out of control!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well... the truth is...

Name: Suzy
Dialog: I've been trying to make Candace look bad all morning!

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Suzy!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: I mean, bubble!

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Get over here Suzy. We're guests here, and guests do not behave like that.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: But Mom, Candace floats!

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Oh, and now you're telling lies.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh, Mrs. Johnson, as much as I hate to admit it, Suzy's not lying. Phineas and Ferb made a ray that makes me weightless. I might as well show you I couldn't embarrass myself more than I already have.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Reverse switch, check. Is it aimed at Candace? Close enough. (He fires the ray)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look! (She removes her hands from the table and floats up, but gets hit with the ray, making her crash down.) Ta da...!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: So dad, what do you think?

Name: Jack
Dialog: She's a lot like your mom.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you Honest Abe Lincoln!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It looks like it worked, Ferb. Candace is just standing there, talking and pointing. Oh, now looks like they're coming out here. hey! Let's show them our anti-gravity maximus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's right out here Mom...It was right here!

Name: Linda
Dialog: And what am I looking at, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It was a machine that made me weightless, it, it... Suzy tell them.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: (pause) Bubble!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh, you heard her, bubble.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Not too shabby.
